public.hero.title: Isigaba sesitshalo sibalwa ngesimo sezulu esenzekile
public.hero.intro: Mecropolis ihlanganisa ama-heat units (GDD) kusukela kutshaliwe, isebenzisa amazinga okushisa aqoshwe yi-Open-Meteo. Isizini ngayinye yaseNtshonalanga Kapa idlulela esigabeni esilandelayo uma isamba sifinyelela emkhawulweni wesitshalo.

public.how.title: Kusukela osukwini lokutshala kuya esigabeni
public.how.lead: Isigaba sivame ukufakwa ngesandla, ngakho siba sesikhathini kuphela uma sisanda kuvuselelwa. Lapha sibalwa ngesimo sezulu esiqoshiwe, futhi lonke ushintsho lugcina ubufakazi balo.
public.step.1.title: Bhala lokho umlimi akwaziyo
public.step.1.body: Amapulazi, amasimu, izitshalo nezinsuku zokutshala kugcinwa ku-Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Landa isimo sezulu esenzekile
public.step.2.body: Amazinga okushisa ansuku zonke endaweni yesimu avela emlandweni we-Open-Meteo, kusukela kutshaliwe kuze kube namuhla.
public.step.3.title: Hlanganisa ama-heat units
public.step.3.body: Ama-heat units (GDD) ayahlanganiswa ngokwemodeli yesitshalo. Uma efinyelela emkhawulweni, uhlelo ludlulisela isizini esigabeni esilandelayo bese luqopha isizathu.
public.models.title: Amamodeli ezitshalo asetshenziswayo
public.models.lead: Ama-heat units adingekayo ukuze isitshalo sivuthwe. Le mininingwane ibhalwe ngesandla futhi ayikabi nayo imithombo.
public.live.title: Isimo epulazini lokubonisa laseSwartland
public.live.lead: Izilinganiso zivela emithonjeni yomphakathi futhi zivuselelwa njalo ngemizuzu engu-30.
public.yields.title: Izilinganiso zesivuno ezishicilelwe
public.honesty.title: Indlela imininingwane ephathwa ngayo
public.honesty.1.title: Isivuno sifakwa ngumsebenzisi
public.honesty.1.body: Kuze kube yilapho umsebenzisi ebhala isivuno, uhlelo lubonisa ukuthi “Asikabhalwa”.
public.honesty.2.title: Izilinganiso ziyimibhalo ehlukene
public.honesty.2.body: Izibalo zesifunda nezwe zigcinwa emibhalweni yazo, nomthombo neyunithi. Aziqhathaniswa nesivuno sensimu.
public.honesty.3.title: Imininingwane yezilokazane ingeyesifunda
public.honesty.3.body: Imibhalo ye-GBIF ibonisa lapho izilokazane ezabonwa khona phakathi kuka-100 km, nebanga lazo.
public.honesty.4.title: Isimo sezulu esamanje
public.honesty.4.body: Amazinga okushisa athathwa emlandweni we-Open-Meteo ngesikhathi ecelwa.
public.open.title: Vula isizini
public.open.body: Ngena kudeshibhodi yesibonelo ukuze ubone ijika le-GDD lesizini nobufakazi besigaba sayo.

public.yield.lead: Lezi zinhlobo ezintathu zedatha zikala izinto ezihlukene ezindaweni ezingalingani. Azinakuqhathaniswa zodwa noma nanoma iyiphi insimu.
public.about.title: Mayelana
public.about.heading: Mayelana ne-Mecropolis
public.about.lead: I-Mecropolis ilandelela amasimu nezitshalo zepulazi laseNtshonalanga Kapa.
public.about.why.title: Kungani ikhona
public.about.why.body: Izigaba zisheshe ziphelelwe isikhathi, kanti izivuno zibhalwa ngokukhumbula. I-Mecropolis ibala isigaba ngesimo sezulu esirekhodiwe. Yonke inombolo ivela kumsebenzisi noma emthonjeni womphakathi obiziwe.
public.about.design.title: Indlela eyakhiwe ngayo
public.about.design.1.body: Ama-heat units (GDD) aqoqwa kusukela ngosuku lokutshala kusetshenziswa umlando we-Open-Meteo. Uma isigaba sishintsha, kugcinwa ubufakazi: usuku esiqale ngalo, isamba se-GDD nokusetshenziswe ukusibala.
public.about.design.2.body: Isigaba esilandela esangaphambi kokuvuna sibizwa ngokuthi ukuvuthwa ngokushisa ngoba akukho kuvuna okurekhodiwe.
public.about.design.4.body: Zigcinwa emibhalweni yazo, nomthombo, iyunithi nelayisensi.
public.about.stack.title: Ubuchwepheshe
public.about.stack.body: Uhlelo lwekhasi elilodwa lwe-Vite ne-React 19 ku-Cloudflare Pages. Isiphequluli sifunda ngqo idatha yomphakathi ye-Sanity nge-GROQ nangokulalela izinguquko ngesikhathi esenzeka ngaso. Okubhalwayo nedatha edinga ukhiye kudlula ku-Cloudflare Pages Functions, ehlola ikhukhi leseshini elisayiniwe. Kusetshenziswa i-Zod lapho idatha ingena noma iphuma, i-Vitest ekuhloleni, ne-Tailwind 4 ekubukekeni.
public.about.limits.title: Imikhawulo eyaziwayo
public.about.limits.1: Amapharamitha emodeli yesitshalo (izinga lokushisa eliyisisekelo, ama-heat units kuze kuhlume nasekuvuthweni) abhalwe ngesandla futhi awakabi nayo imithombo.
public.about.limits.2: Isilinganiso se-lupin sivela ku-HarvestStat seminyaka ka-2000 kuya ku-2007 kuphela, futhi ukufakwa kwedatha kokuqala akutholanga mibhalo yesilinganiso se-lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Idatha yezilokazane iyimibhalo ye-GBIF yezinto ezabonwa eduze kwepulazi. Ibonisa lapho uhlobo oluthile lwabhalwa khona eduze kwepulazi.
public.about.limits.4: Isibonelo sisebenzisa ukungena okukodwa okwabelwana ngakho nomkhawulo wezicelo ogcinwa enkumbulweni. Ukungena kufihla amakhasi edeshibhodi kodwa akuvikeli idatha: wonke umuntu angayifunda. Kodwa kuvikela konke okubhalwayo.

docs.title: Imibhalo yosizo
docs.heading: Ukusetha ne-API
docs.lead: Indlela yokusebenzisa i-Mecropolis kukhompyutha yakho nokwenziwa izindawo zayo zokuxhuma.
docs.setup.title: Ukusetha
docs.setup.serves: Uhlelo lusebenza ku-{0}, bese ludlulisela u-{1} ku-Pages Functions eku-{2}. Izilungiselelo zesiphequluli zifundwa ngemojuli eyodwa, kanti ama-Functions ahlola ezawo; akukho okuqalayo uma kukhona okuguquguqukayo okungekho.
docs.env.title: Okuguquguqukayo kwendawo
docs.env.sessionSecret: Isayina ikhukhi leseshini (izinhlamvu ezingu-32 noma ngaphezulu)
docs.env.fasKey: Ukufinyelela ku-USDA FAS PSD, okwe-Functions kuphela
docs.stages.title: Uhlelo lwezigaba
docs.stages.guards: Ukudlulela esigabeni ngasinye kunemibandela. Isigaba sokutshaliwe sidinga usuku lokutshala nesitshalo; esokukhula sidinga umkhawulo wama-heat units wokuhluma; esangaphambi kokuvuna sidinga u-90% womkhawulo wokuvuthwa; ukuvuthwa ngokushisa kudinga ukufinyelela emkhawulweni wokuvuthwa; ukubuyekeza kudinga isifinyezo sesimo sezulu sesizini nesilinganiso esiqinisekisiwe. Imibandela ye-GDD idinga nedatha yezinga lokushisa okungenani ku-90% wesikhathi, futhi ukudlulela esigabeni esinosuku oluzayo kuyavinjelwa.
docs.endpoints.title: Izindawo zokuxhuma
docs.endpoints.errors: Amaphutha abuyisa u-{0}. Ukubhala kudinga nesicelo esivela kule sayithi.
docs.ep.advance: Dlulisela isizini phambili (iseshini idinga i-seasonId), noma ngethokheni udlulisele wonke amasizini phambili nge-GDD
docs.ep.scenario: Bala i-GDD yokuhlola isimo; akukho okugcinwayo
docs.ep.weather: Isibikezelo, umlando noma ukuqagela kwesimo sezulu sensimu
docs.ep.landing: Isimo sezulu, umhlabathi, izinambuzane nesivuno sendawo yesibonelo
docs.ep.conditions: Isimo sezulu, umhlabathi nezinambuzane zepulazi elilodwa
docs.seed.title: Ukufaka imininingwane yokuqala
docs.seed.body: {0} kufaka ipulazi lesibonelo, amasimu, izitshalo nezinkathi kudathasethi emisiwe, bese kuvumelanisa izilinganiso zesifunda. Kususa kufake okusha esikhundleni sepulazi, amasimu nezitshalo, ngakho kusebenzise kuphela kudathasethi okungeyakho.
guide.title: Isetshenziswa kanjani i-Mecropolis
guide.lead: Umhlahlandlela omfushane ngamagama alula. Uchaza ukuthi uhlelo lwenzelweni, olwabani nokuthi ingxenye ngayinye yenzani.
guide.what.title: Iyini i-Mecropolis
guide.what.p1: I-Mecropolis ilandelela amasimu nezitshalo epulazini. Ibala ukuthi isitshalo sesikhule kangakanani ngokuhlanganisa ukufudumala esikuthole selokhu satshalwa. Iphinde ibonise isimo sezulu, umhlabathi nezinambuzane eziseduze nepulazi lakho endaweni eyodwa.
guide.what.p2: Yenzelwe amapulazi aseNtshonalanga Kapa eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa isebenza kunoma yiliphi ipulazi, isifunda noma inkathi.
guide.who.title: Yenzelwe bani
guide.who.p1: Yenzelwe umuntu onakekela amasimu, njengomlimi, umphathi wepulazi noma umeluleki wabo.
guide.who.p2: Akudingeki wazi ngamakhompyutha noma ngesayensi yesimo sezulu. Uma ukwazi ukuvula iwebhusayithi, ungayisebenzisa i-Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Kungani ungayisebenzisa
guide.why.1: Ungabona ngokushesha ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezisanda kutshalwa, ezikhulayo neziseceleni kokuvuthwa.
guide.why.2: Akudingeki ubuyekeze insimu ngayinye ngesandla. Uhlelo luyisa isitshalo esigabeni esilandelayo uma isimo sezulu sikhombisa ukuthi sekuyisikhathi.
guide.why.3: Lukuxwayisa ngesithwathwa nokushisa kwezinsuku ezizayo, nangezinambuzane ezibonwe eduze nepulazi lakho.
guide.why.4: Konke okubhalwe ngensimu, njengokufafaza, isinambuzane osibonile noma inothi, kugcinwa endaweni eyodwa nosuku lwakho ukuze ukubheke kamuva.
guide.why.5: Inombolo ngayinye ikhombisa lapho ivela khona, ukuze wazi ukuthi yini ongayethemba.
guide.heat.title: Uhlelo lwazi kanjani ukuthi isitshalo sikusiphi isigaba
guide.heat.p1: Izitshalo zikhula ngokushesha uma kufudumele, zikhule kancane uma kubanda. I-Mecropolis ibala lokhu kufudumala nsuku zonke njengamayunithi okushisa, ososayensi abawabiza nge-growing degree days noma i-GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Usuku ngalunye ithatha isilinganiso sezinga lokushisa eliphezulu neliphansi, bese isusa izinga lapho isitshalo siyeka ukukhula khona. Okusalayo ngamayunithi okushisa alolo suku. Usuku olubandayo alwengezi lutho.
guide.heat.p3: Isitshalo ngasinye sidinga isamba esithile samayunithi okushisa ngaphambi kokuvuthwa. Uma isamba sangemva kokutshala sisondela kulelo nani, isitshalo siya esigabeni esilandelayo.
guide.heat.p4: Amazinga okushisa avela ku-Open-Meteo, isevisi yamahhala egcina isimo sezulu sazo zonke izindawo emhlabeni.
guide.stages.title: Izigaba eziyisithupha
guide.stages.intro: Zonke izitshalo kuwo wonke amasimu zidlula kulezi zigaba ngokulandelana.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Isitshalo sesiqoqe cishe konke ukushisa esikudingayo, ngakho sekuyisikhathi sokulungiselela ukuvuna.
guide.stages.harvested: Isitshalo sesiqoqe konke ukushisa esikudingayo, ngakho kufanele sibe sesivuthiwe. Nguwe kuphela ongasho ukuthi sivuniwe ngempela, ngakho uhlelo luthi sesivuthwe ngokokushisa.
guide.stages.review: Inkathi isiphelile, usungabheka ukuthi ihambe kanjani.
guide.stages.p2: Uhlelo luhlola isitshalo ngasinye njalo ebusuku nalapho umuntu efaka akubonile noma umsebenzi awenzile. Ungacindezela nokuthi Hlola manje enkathini ukuze luhlole ngaso leso sikhathi.
guide.start.title: Ukuqalisa
guide.start.1: Vula ikhasi lasekhaya. Ungabona ibalazwe lesimo sezulu, umhlabathi, izinambuzane nesivuno sepulazi lesibonelo ngaphandle kokungena ngemvume.
guide.start.2: Cindezela okuthi Ngena ngemvume phezulu, usebenzise imininingwane ye-akhawunti yesibonelo oyinikiwe.
guide.start.3: Khetha ipulazi. Lokhu kuvula ideshibhodi yalelo pulazi.
guide.start.4: Cindezela inkathi ukuze ubone konke ngaleso sitshalo kuleyo nsimu.
guide.start.5: Sebenzisa ibhokisi lolimi phezulu kunoma yiliphi ikhasi ukuze ushintshe ulimi. Uhlelo luyalukhumbula uma ubuya.
guide.home.title: Ikhasi lasekhaya
guide.home.p1: Ikhasi lasekhaya libonisa ibalazwe lesifunda elinemibala ekhombisa ukuthi umhlaba uthole ukushisa okungakanani kule nkathi. Libonisa nesimo sezulu samanje nesezinsuku ezizayo, umhlabathi wepulazi lesibonelo, izinambuzane ezisanda kubonwa eduze nesilinganiso sesivuno sesifunda. Akudingeki ungene ngemvume ukuze ukubone.
guide.dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yepulazi
guide.dashboard.intro: Ideshibhodi ibonisa ipulazi elilodwa. Lezi izingxenye zayo kusukela phezulu kuye phansi. Ibhokisi lepulazi phezulu likuvumela ukushintshela kwelinye ipulazi.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Isifinyezo sepulazi
guide.dashboard.summary: Inani lamasimu namahektha epulazi, izinkathi eziqhubekayo nezitshalo esezivuthiwe.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Okudinga ukunakwa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Izixwayiso ezimfushane, njengesithwathwa noma ukushisa okubikezelwe, isitshalo esivuthiwe, inkathi engaqalanga ngesikhathi noma izinambuzane ezibonwe eduze nensimu. Isixwayiso ngasinye sisho imbangela yaso.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Isimo sepulazi
guide.dashboard.conditions: Isimo sezulu sanamuhla, isibikezelo, umhlabathi nezinambuzane eziseduze naleli pulazi.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Ukuqhubeka kwenkathi
guide.dashboard.progress: Ikhadi lesitshalo ngasinye elibonisa ukuthi sesiqoqe ukushisa okungakanani. Ungaqhathanisa amasimu bese ulanda uhlu njengefayela lespredishithi (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Amasimu
guide.dashboard.fields: Wonke amasimu epulazini, ubukhulu bawo, umhlabathi nezitshalo zawo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Sesha amarekhodi
guide.dashboard.search: Bhala okufunayo ngamagama ajwayelekile, njengokuthi izintwala zikakolweni. Kuthola okubonwe ensimini nemisebenzi enencazelo efanayo, noma kubhalwe ngamanye amagama.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Izincomo
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Umsebenzi ophakanyisiwe wensimu, njengokufafaza noma ukufaka umanyolo. Ungavuma noma wenqabe ngamunye, bese uwumaka njengoqediwe uma umsebenzi usuphelile.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Okwenzeke kamuva
guide.dashboard.activity: Uhlu lwezikhathi lapho isitshalo ngasinye sidlulele esigabeni esisha.
guide.season.title: Ikhasi lenkathi
guide.season.intro: Inkathi yisitshalo esisodwa ensimini eyodwa ngonyaka owodwa. Ikhasi layo linakho konke okuphathelene nayo.
guide.season.top.label: Phezulu kwekhasi
guide.season.top: Isitshalo, insimu, usuku lokutshala, usuku lokuvuna olulindelekile nesivuno uma ususifakile.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Ukulandelana kwezigaba
guide.season.pipeline: Izigaba eziyisithupha, kumakwe esamanje. Cindezela okuthi Hlola manje ukuze ubone ngokushesha ukuthi isitshalo kufanele sidlulele phambili yini.
guide.season.readiness.label: Ukulungela isinqumo
guide.season.readiness: Uhlu lwezinto uhlelo oluzidingayo ngaphambi kokuyisa isitshalo phambili, njengosuku lokutshala nemininingwane eyanele yesimo sezulu. Into ngayinye ithi Kuphumelele, Isexwayiso noma Kuvinjiwe. Uma ivinjiwe, isho okushodayo.
guide.season.evidence.label: Ubufakazi
guide.season.evidence: Amarekhodi uhlelo oluwasebenzisile ukwenza izinqumo, ukuze uwahlole.
guide.season.propose.label: Phakamisa isincomo
guide.season.propose: Phakamisa umsebenzi wale nsimu, unamathisele ubufakazi benkathi. Uhlala njengohlaka kuze kube othile ewuvuma kudeshibhodi.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Ishadi lamayunithi okushisa aqoqeka kusukela kutshalwa, elinomugqa wesamba esidingwa isitshalo.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Kungenzekani uma...?
guide.season.whatIf: Zama usuku lokutshala olungaphambili noma olungemuva, noma inkathi efudumele noma ebandayo, ubone ukuthi amayunithi okushisa angashintsha kanjani. Akukho okugcinwayo.
guide.season.summary.label: Isifinyezo senkathi
guide.season.summary: Isifinyezo esifushane samarekhodi enkathi esibhalwe yi-AI. Sisebenzise njengosizo, bese uhlola amarekhodi uma kukhona okungabonakali kulungile.
guide.season.notes.label: Amanothi enkathi
guide.season.notes: Amanothi enkathi anezinsuku. Ungawafaka, uwashintshe noma uwasuse, futhi ubuyise inguqulo endala yenothi.
guide.season.files.label: Isithombe sensimu nombiko wokuhlolwa komhlabathi
guide.season.files: Layisha isithombe sensimu ne-PDF yokuhlolwa komhlabathi evela elabhorethri.
guide.season.log.label: Irekhodi lensimu
guide.season.log: Okubone ensimini nalokho okwenzile kuyo, njengokufafaza nomkhiqizo nesilinganiso sawo.
guide.season.history.label: Umlando wezinguquko
guide.season.history: Zonke izinguquko ezigciniwe zale nkathi nezinsuku zazo.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Isilinganiso sesifunda
guide.season.benchmark: Isilinganiso sesivuno sesifunda esivela ezibalweni zomphakathi. Esokuqhathanisa kuphela, akusona isivuno sensimu yakho.
guide.season.pests.label: Izinambuzane ezibikwe esifundeni
guide.season.pests: Izinambuzane ezibikwe eduze nensimu ku-GBIF, isizindalwazi somphakathi sezinto ezibonwe. Cindezela okuthi Landa okubonwe ukuze uthole okwakamuva.
guide.sources.title: Izinombolo zivela kuphi
guide.sources.weather: Isimo sezulu sivela ku-Open-Meteo, sanamuhla, esibikezelwe nesezinsuku ezidlule.
guide.sources.soil: Imininingwane yomhlabathi ivela ku-SoilGrids, ibalazwe lomhlaba wonke lomhlabathi.
guide.sources.pests: Okubonwe ngezinambuzane kuvela ku-GBIF, isizindalwazi somphakathi sezinto ezibonwe.
guide.sources.yields: Isivuno sesifunda sivela ku-USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa nase-World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Konke okunye, njengamanothi, imisebenzi nesivuno sakho, kufakwe nguwe noma ithimba lakho.
guide.limits.title: Lokho engeke ikwenze
guide.limits.model: Amayunithi okushisa adingwa isitshalo ngasinye ayizilinganiso zethu futhi awakahlolwa ensimini. Wasebenzise njengomhlahlandlela, wethembe lokho okubona ensimini yakho.
guide.limits.maturity: Ukuvuthwa ngokushisa kusho ukuthi ngokwesimo sezulu isilimo kufanele sesilungele ukuvunwa. Nguwe kuphela owaziyo ukuthi sesilungele ngempela yini.
guide.limits.translation: Ukuhumusha kwenziwe yi-AI. Kufanele kube lula ukukuqonda, kodwa akuzona zonke izilimi ezihlolwe umuntu ozikhuluma kahle.
guide.limits.demo: Idemo ivulekele wonke umuntu, ngakho ungafaki imininingwane eyimfihlo.
dashboard.picker.heading: Yiliphi ipulazi ofuna ukulivakashela namuhla?
dashboard.picker.intro: Khetha ipulazi ukuze uvule imininingwane yalo.
dashboard.picker.empty: Awekho amapulazi okwamanje. Sebenzisa i-seed script ukuze uwafake.
